Dylan —

Thanks for taking the time this morning. Per our conversation, I wanted to capture a concise 30-day remediation plan and the mutual commitments so there’s no ambiguity going forward. This is a pre-PIP coaching plan intended to give you focused support; it is not a formal PIP at this stage but we will use measurable checkpoints to decide next steps. Monica is looped in for HR guidance. Lauren is cc’d as your skip-level.

Key areas of concern (summary):
- Consistent missed delivery SLAs on the realtime routing project (missed three sprint commitments, 2 production incidents where fixes overlapped release window).
- Lack of proactive communication when timelines slip (owners not looped early).
- Quality gaps on critical unit/integration tests (flaky test fixes pushed without root-cause documentation).

30-day remediation plan (starting Monday, 2026-03-02):
1) Goals (measurable):
   - Deliver the realtime routing bugfix branch with green CI and no regressions by 2026-03-20.
   - Reduce ticket reopen rate for your PRs to <= 5% over the period.
   - Maintain daily standup updates in the project thread and post end-of-day notes on Slack.
2) Support and resources:
   - Pairing time: Lauren and I will reserve 2x 60-minute pairing blocks per week for deep-dive reviews.
   - QA assistance: Monica will coordinate a dedicated QA pass the week of 2026-03-15.
3) Checkpoints:
   - Weekly 1:1s on Tuesdays at 10:30am (first checkpoint: 2026-03-03).
   - Midpoint asynchronous status update on 2026-03-13 (email + brief demo).
   - Final review on 2026-03-30 to determine whether formal PIP is needed.

Deliverables I expect from you (concrete):
- Daily standup post and EOD note in the project channel.
- Root-cause write-up for the three production incidents (one-pager each) by 2026-03-08.
- Fully passing branch + test logs + deployment checklist for the routing fix by 2026-03-20.

I’ve attached a short coaching checklist (see attachment) and an examples log template for the incidents. Please reply to confirm you understand and whether the timeline is feasible; if you need different dates we’ll adjust now rather than later.

Thanks — we want to see you succeed here and will give concrete help to get back on track.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
